Character.Name: Zayden
Character.Description: A former A.T.P. engineer who fixes more than machines. Zayden broke into a Z-52 facility to steal equipment, got caught, and escaped with a target on his back. That raid turned a bad decision into a long-running vendetta. He still takes risky jobs, but now he measures every shortcut against the danger it puts Zenith and Zephyr in.
Character.Title: Rogue Engineer

Character.Name: Zenith
Character.Description: A former A.A.H.W. Soldat who walked away from the agency and its orders. Zenith brings discipline, a reinforced Soldat kit, and a dry sense of humor to the crew with Zayden. He backs his friend by choice now, not because a command channel told him to.
Character.Title: Reformed A.T.P. Soldat

Character.Name: Zephyr
Character.Description: A former A.A.H.W. agent who chose a life outside the uniform. Zephyr is quick with a warning and quicker with a joke, but never careless about an exit. He and Zayden have history, and he trusts Zenith to watch their backs when the plan goes sideways.
Character.Title: Reformed A.A.H.W. Agent

Chatter.Name: Zayden - original crew chatter
Chatter.Description: Role-specific combat dialogue for Zayden, written for the crew.
Spawned: Give me a panel and thirty seconds.
WakeUp: That lock was supposed to stay shut.
Chasing: Service run, left side! I know this place.
Waiting: Checking the door. Give me a second.
FriendDied: Zenith, cover me! I am getting them out.
Wounded: I am hit. Still have both hands.
Died: Tell the guys... I owe them one.

Chatter.Name: Zenith - original crew chatter
Chatter.Description: Role-specific combat dialogue for Zenith, written for the crew.
Spawned: Zenith on point. Stay behind my plate.
Chasing: They are heading for the stairs. I will cut them off.
Waiting: Holding the line. Move when you are ready.
EnemyDown: Threat handled. Check the next corner.
Wounded: Armor took most of it. I am still good.
Died: Keep moving. Do not make this for nothing.

Chatter.Name: Zephyr - original crew chatter
Chatter.Description: Role-specific combat dialogue for Zephyr, written for the crew.
Spawned: I see the exits. I always see the exits.
WakeUp: That was not the wind. Heads up.
Chasing: I will take the short way around.
Waiting: Got your back. Try not to make me say it twice.
FriendDied: No. Stay with us. We are not leaving you.
EnemyDown: That one is out. Anyone else?
Wounded: I have had worse. Keep moving.
Died: Tell Zayden... no more stupid plans.

Origin.Name: Workshop Rat
Origin.Description: You grew up around service corridors, repair benches, and machines that only worked if you knew which panel to kick. Your grease-stained engineer coveralls, amber work goggles, and battered hardhat are as familiar as the tools on your belt. You keep one extra magazine ready, but machinery taught you more than hand-to-hand fighting.

Buffs.Description: Your work kit has room for one extra magazine.
Buffs.Name: Bonus Magazine

Buffs.Description: You never trained much for close-quarters fights.
Buffs.Name: Damage from Unarmed/Melee

Origin.Name: A.A.H.W. Defector
Origin.Description: You once followed A.A.H.W. orders because that was the only life you knew. Then the orders stopped making sense. You left your standard uniform behind for a weathered field coat, a scavenged work vest, and tinted shades. You still know how to operate, but you no longer have the agency backing you up.

Buffs.Description: Field training taught you to keep one extra pistol magazine ready.
Buffs.Name: Pistol Magazine

Buffs.Description: Without agency support, you keep your kit light.
Buffs.Name: Encumbrance

Origin.Name: Z-52 Fugitive
Origin.Description: You got caught stealing from a Z-52 facility. You ditched the clean tactical kit and disappeared into the back roads in a patched bandit jacket, rough face covering, and an overstuffed escape pack. They remember your face anyway, and staying wanted costs you.

Buffs.Description: You learned to take slightly faster follow-up shots.
Buffs.Name: Careful Shot

Buffs.Description: Keeping ahead of Z-52 cuts into your earnings.
Buffs.Name: Wanted

Origin.Name: Highway Survivor
Origin.Description: You crossed Nevada one bad road at a time, piecing together a travel-worn jacket, a bandolier, and a battered goggle hood from whatever you found. You can keep your footing after a hard hit, but long-range gunfights still catch you exposed.

Buffs.Description: A little road experience helps you shake off dizziness.
Buffs.Name: Keep Your Feet

Buffs.Description: You never had proper training against ranged fire.
Buffs.Name: Exposed

Origin.Name: Deep Salvager
Origin.Description: You spent years pulling useful parts from sealed shafts and dead industrial blocks. The patched mining suit, filter mask, and scratched radiation goggles are practical armor for places where a wrong breath can end a shift. You know how to keep a weapon fed, but the heavy salvage pack slows you down.

Buffs.Description: You keep one extra magazine for your main weapon.
Buffs.Name: Scavenged Ammunition

Buffs.Description: The salvage pack makes quick movement harder.
Buffs.Name: Loaded Down

Origin.Name: Rail Runner
Origin.Description: You learned to move between settlements along service rails and freight yards, carrying only what you could sprint with. A scavenged pilot helmet and flight jacket mark the routes you ran. You handle sidearms cleanly, but you never had the patience for long, careful aim.

Buffs.Description: A little practice helps with follow-up pistol shots.
Buffs.Name: Quick Draw

Buffs.Description: Your fast-moving style makes ranged shots less steady.
Buffs.Name: Rushed Aim

Origin.Name: Pit Veteran
Origin.Description: You survived backroom fight pits where a clean win mattered less than getting up for the next round. The battered hockey mask and long coat hide old bruises; the boxing gloves are worn smooth at the knuckles. You know how to finish a close fight, but gunfire still forces you to keep your head down.

Buffs.Description: Pit work gives you a small edge in hand-to-hand damage.
Buffs.Name: Close-Quarters Habit

Buffs.Description: You have less practice avoiding ranged fire.
Buffs.Name: Open-Lane Risk

Origin.Name: Clinic Runner
Origin.Description: When the district clinics lost power, you became the person who carried supplies through blocked streets. A stained medical jacket, respirator, and improvised defib gloves still travel with you. You keep your footing after a hit, but the medical kit limits how freely you can move.

Buffs.Description: Clinic work taught you to stay alert after a hard hit.
Buffs.Name: Steady After Impact

Buffs.Description: The supply pack makes movement a little harder.
Buffs.Name: Medical Load
